decisive_items: scattered red blood cell fragments (schistocytes) among normal red blood cells
response.rationale: C2 is the most complete TTP candidate because it combines the core MAHA/thrombocytopenia evidence with the explicitly high PLASMIC score. R2 (DIC) is the closest alternative but is disfavored by normal fibrinogen, normal PTT, and only mildly elevated INR, while the high PLASMIC score strongly favors TTP. R1/C1 only explain the cancer history and do not address the acute microangiopathic hemolytic anemia.

rejected.why: Explains the cancer history and metastases but does not account for schistocytes, thrombocytopenia, low haptoglobin, high LDH, or the high PLASMIC score.
Redundant append-only completion of R1; only restates the gastric primary and adds no acute hematologic explanation.
Correlated restatement of C2 without the decisive PLASMIC score span; superseded by C2 on composite completeness.
